sectors.trend: Positive exploration pipeline (44g/t gold King River, 2.7% tungsten Viking, titanium McLaren, antimony Larvotto) alongside coal price recovery. MIN.AX ASIC overhang cleared. However, oil-driven inflation pressures input costs.
sectors.implications: Exploration names (KRG, MLD, VIK, LRV) gain speculative interest; coal producers (BHP.AX, WDS.AX, BOQ.AX) benefit from price rebound. MIN.AX de-risked. Watch iron ore/coal correlation with Middle East risk premium.

sectors.trend: Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes; Bathla developer near collapse signals NPL risk. Rate-hike fears pressure bond yields and mortgage demand. QAN.AX strike risk adds operational uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit provisioning risk in property segment. QAN.AX strike vote is a near-term operational risk. Defensive bank positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs Trump administration price-cutting deal — significant margin compression risk for its US revenue stream. Weight-loss drug demand surging domestically.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces structural pricing headwind in largest export market; near-term share price pressure likely. Domestic GLP-1 demand supports consumer health names.

sectors.trend: Oil spike on Middle East tensions; diesel shock described as permanent. Danish wind farm entrant signals renewable pipeline revival. Coal boom supports thermal generators.
sectors.implications: Energy names (WDS.AX, BOQ.AX, SXG.AX) benefit from oil/coal prices. Renewables (IGW.AX, LNC.AX) gain from wind farm catalyst. Diesel cost inflation pressures transport/logistics.

sectors.trend: Sydney house price crash global headline; negative gearing reform muted; renter respite emerging. Bathla collapse and property credit crash signal housing stress. QAN.AX strike disrupts travel.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals — rent stability vs. occupancy risk. Housing builders under pressure. Consumer discretionary cautious amid per-capita recession fears.

sectors.trend: Central banker warns AI 'contagion risk' for global economy. Canva (CVA.AX) faces employee privacy legal fight. US tech (CRM, CRWD, GOOGL) shows mixed AI monetisation signals.
sectors.implications: CVA.AX legal overhang; broader AI capex cycle under scrutiny. Australian tech names remain small-cap; sentiment driven by US peers.

Avoid high-yield property credit; monitor bank NPL disclosures; favour diversified financials over property-heavy lenders

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reassess CSL.AX earnings model; consider reducing position pending guidance; monitor CSL free cash flow trajectory
Hedge energy exposure; monitor Brent/WTI; favour domestic energy producers over importers

Removal of Ellison investigation overhang eliminates key governance risk; lithium/iron ore exposure remains strategically relevant

opportunities.rationale: Danish entrant signals pipeline revival; policy support for renewables offsets diesel cost inflation narrative

defensive_moves.rationale: Property credit crash, Bathla collapse, and rate-hike fears create downside risk for REITs and builders

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim or hedge CSL.AX pending margin guidance
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump administration price-cutting deal introduces structural US revenue compression; wait for updated guidance

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX near-term; favour defensive consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Strike vote creates operational and reputational risk; staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) offer defensive yield

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/short-duration bonds as inflation hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Home-grown inflation and rate-hike risk favour fixed income; debt spiral warning adds macro caution

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely under pressure over 1–3 months as oil-driven inflation keeps RBA on hold or hawkish. Property credit stress and CSL margin risk weigh on financials and healthcare. Coal/energy and exploration names provide relative outperformance. QAN strike adds volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if inflation moderates and RBA pivots. Coal and commodity cycle supports materials. CSL deal impact will be digested; domestic GLP-1 demand offsets. Housing stabilisation post-crash could support REITs by 2027. AI contagion risk remains a tail risk. Per-capita recession narrative may persist, capping consumer recovery.
